notes_for_editor: Two register-level facts only: 1937 build for the Wisconsin DNR and the 2017 registration. No staffing, fire history or sale year found in the sources read. The FFLA 2021 divestment count covers Wisconsin as a whole and does not name Dairyland; its 39 total includes towers that reverted to the Menominee Tribe, USFS and Department of Military Affairs. Access is undocumented; the record's access 'unknown' could now read 'private'. The NHLR photo credit (Brian Ziegler, all rights reserved) is already in the record.
